title: Exercise 4: Gateway Switch with Environment Variables
description: Seven lines set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to route through the local gateway, change to an exercise directory, launch claude, then inside the session ask what model it is and use /model to switch models.

steps.description: Lines 2-3 export the two environment variables that redirect API calls to the local gateway. Lines 4-5 change directory and launch claude. Lines 6-7 are in-session commands: ask the model name, then use /model to see and switch models.
Lines 2-3 are the gateway redirect: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL overrides the default endpoint, and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY uses a placeholder the gateway ignores.

steps.question: What should the agent's response to "what model are you?" name?
steps.answer: a model served by your local gateway (not the default Anthropic cloud model)
